observations.body: The Word becomes flesh and dwells among people; the witness says, “We saw his glory,” as of the Father’s only Son.
observations.label: John speaks of beholding the Word’s glory: action

observations.body: Grace and truth, Moses, law, and the Son who makes God known are held together.

payload.posture: Read John 1:14–18 as glory, transformation, and remembered testimony evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The transfiguration must not be inserted as the only event meant by “we saw his glory.”
